newsitem.title: USA: Daw Technologies receives $4 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Daw Technologies receives $4 mln contract.

text.p: Daw Technologies Inc said Tuesday it received a $4 million contract from a North American company to provide a complete turnkey solution, including the design, engineering and project management for the cleanroom portion of the facility.
Daw said in a release that the company is a subsidiary of a major Asia Pacific corporation and is a leading manufacturer of computer hard disk drives, but did not provide any names.
Daw was not immediately available for comment.
The project begins immediately and is expected to be completed sometime in the second quarter of 1997, Daw said.
